answers.explanation: POP3 is download-and-delete, like emptying a PO box.
Flags are stored on the server, so every device sees them.
RETR retrieves it, DELE marks it deleted.
Keeping mail on the server costs storage, but that's also what lets every device see it.
Webmail is a website over HTTPS. The server does the mailbox work.
IDLE keeps the connection open so the server can announce new messages.
IMAP: folders and flags live on the server.
